name: Claim Jumper

abilities.text: When ~ enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, you may search your library for a Plains card and put it onto the battlefield tapped. Then if an opponent controls more lands than you, repeat this process once. If you search your library this way, shuffle.

notes: 'Repeat this process once' is written out as a second, conditional copy of the same optional search; the search op shuffles the library itself, so the trailing 'If you search your library this way, shuffle' needs no separate effect.

issues: When this creature enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, ... — expected Intervening-if re-checked on resolution as well as on triggering. — scripted Correctly written as `intervening`, but src/engine/game.ts:2208 only evaluates it when the trigger goes on the stack; it is never re-checked at resolution. Engine gap, not a script error — the script uses the right construct. — CR CR 603.4

you may search your library for a Plains card and put it onto the battlefield tapped — expected One optional search; 'a Plains card' includes nonbasic Plains; enters tapped; shuffle only if you actually searched. — scripted op 'may' wrapping search {subtypes:['Plains']} (no basic:true — correct), to battlefield, tapped:true, count 1, optional:true. Search shuffles internally (game.ts:1240) and is skipped entirely when the may is declined, so 'If you search your library this way, shuffle' is handled. Triple optionality (ability.optional + may + search.optional) is redundant — ability.optional has no consumer in the engine and search.optional only relaxes exact:false (fail to find) — so it yields exactly one prompt, but it is untidy.

Then if an opponent controls more lands than you, repeat this process once. — expected Re-check after the first land has entered; at most one repeat. — scripted op 'conditional' with the same opponent-more-lands condition wrapping one more may+search — evaluated at that point in resolution with the new land on the battlefield, and non-recursive so it cannot repeat more than once. Correct.
Vigilance — expected Vigilance granted. — scripted keywords:['vigilance'] with a covers entry; scenario 4 exercises it.

When this creature enters, if an opponent controls more lands than you, you may search ... Then if an opponent controls more lands than you, repeat this process once. — expected intervening-if on the trigger; optional search to battlefield tapped; a second, separately-conditioned optional search; shuffle if you searched — scripted intervening opponent-more-lands, may+search(subtypes Plains, to battlefield, tapped, count 1), then conditional opponent-more-lands wrapping an identical may+search. Matches clause for clause. 'a Plains card' correctly filters on subtype only (a nonbasic Plains qualifies), and search shuffles internally (game.ts:1239) so the trailing shuffle needs no op. — CR 603.4; 701.19

you may search your library for a Plains card — expected a single 'you may' gate — scripted ability-level `optional: true` plus the `may` op plus `search.optional: true` — three redundant markers. Only the `may` op and the search's `exact: !optional` are actually read by the engine, so behavior is right; the extra flags are dead metadata. — CR 603.1
